speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
title: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Bishop Sean Douglas spoke about “The Hour of Your Mission Is Come”.

quotes.text: We love missionaries of all ages. You are an army of righteousness with the doctrine of Christ as your purpose. You are a force of faith, power, love, and joy. You are what you preach. You are not only the messengers but also living examples of the message. Make no mistake—you are doing the most important work you could be doing. We thank you for building up the kingdom of God on earth.
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: They reminded me of the sons of Mosiah in the Book of Mormon, who “were desirous that salvation should be declared to every creature, for they could not bear that any human soul should perish.”
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Their desire to serve the Lord rose above every other personal ambition. It’s what makes missionaries special; it’s why they radiate the Light of Christ and teach with convincing power. For a season, all else takes a back seat—education, dating, careers, family time, and even sleeping in on Saturday mornings. Yes, the Lord’s expectations are high for you! But, oh, is it worth it! President Russell M. Nelson taught, “Nothing else compares in magnitude, nothing else compares in importance, nothing else compares in majesty.”
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: God held you in reserve for this time. You were taught and prepared, before you were born, to invite God’s children to come unto Christ. We could say this is in your spiritual DNA. Take care not to become distracted. Prioritize it; don’t let anything get in the way. You are needed!
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Sister Douglas and I served as mission leaders in Lima, Peru. One of our amazing missionaries was Elder Merlin Sanchez. Merlin was baptized when he was nearly 24 years old. As some do, he stopped participating for a time. A faithful friend helped him begin to fill out his mission papers and schedule a physical exam, even though Merlin had not yet decided to serve a mission.
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: With the help of friends and leaders, Merlin returned to church at age 25. A desire to serve a mission suddenly swelled in his heart. Thankfully, his mission papers were well advanced. Once he made the decision to go, it was miraculous to see how the Lord removed seemingly insurmountable obstacles one by one. When I asked him why he wanted to serve, he replied, “I only want to be close to Jesus Christ and to follow Him.”
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: He became a wonderful missionary, converted to Jesus Christ and His doctrine. His every experience, trial, and companion was consecrated for his gain. Interestingly, Elder Sanchez served with the same companion twice, for a total of eight months. Though opposite in personality, they became united in purpose—assigned together by divine design.
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Merlin met his eternal sweetheart, Gali, just a few months following his mission. On the day of their marriage, he was called to be a bishop—quite the wedding gift! There was no time for his discipleship to be interrupted or his faith to be diminished. After all, serving a mission is just one of many significant steps on the path of lifelong discipleship.
quotes.speaker: Bishop Sean Douglas
quotes.talk: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
